name: Romania (1948–1952)
description: Three equal vertical stripes of blue, yellow and red with the first emblem of the Romanian People's Republic, a rising sun over mountains within a wheat wreath, on the yellow stripe.
history: The first flag of the Romanian People's Republic with the new state emblem, adopted after the proclamation of the republic on 30 December 1947 had outlawed the royal arms; the emblem, a sunrise over the Carpathians, was designed in 1948. In 1952 the emblem was redrawn with a red star.

features.role: emblem of the Romanian People's Republic (1948)
